edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Ownable constructor.
Ownable constructor assigns the caller-controlled address to owner.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership logic.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads msg.sender in its require statement.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner modifier guards setReleaseTime execution.
_token parameter is stored into the token state variable.
_beneficiary parameter is stored into the beneficiary state variable.
block.timestamp determines releaseTime during construction (timestamp dependency).
Constructor writes the token state variable.
Constructor writes the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor writes releaseTime derived from block.timestamp.
release() require uses block.timestamp to gate execution (timestamp dependency).
releaseTime is read in the release() require check.
beneficiary is read inside release().
token is read inside release() for balanceOf.
release() assigns token.balanceOf(this) to the amount local variable.
local amount is the value passed to the external safeTransfer call.
beneficiary is the recipient of the external token transfer.
token contract is the target of the external call, enabling reentrancy.
release() invokes the external safeTransfer operation.
External token transfer can call back into release() before state is settled.
